name: Ventas
description: Ventas is a healthcare real estate investment trust that owned or had investments in 1,409 properties at Dec 31, 2025: senior housing communities, outpatient medical buildings, research (lab) centers, hospitals and other healthcare facilities in North America and the United Kingdom. Half of its income comes from the senior housing operating portfolio (SHOP), where Ventas owns the buildings and keeps the resident revenue and operating costs, while 39 outside managers (Atria, Sunrise, Le Groupe Maurice and others) run them. The rest is rent: multi-tenant outpatient medical and research buildings leased to health systems, doctors, universities and biotech firms, and triple-net leases of senior housing, skilled nursing and hospitals where the tenant pays all property costs. A small non-segment piece earns fees and promotes from a third-party private capital platform (Ventas Investment Management) and interest on loans.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label as shown in Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (sector and sub-industry columns only; that list does not give industry group or industry). Read 2026-09-30.

businessLines.name: Senior housing operating portfolio (SHOP)
businessLines.how: Residents pay monthly fees for rent, care and services; Ventas books the full resident revenue and bears the operating costs, then pays the manager a fee. Growth comes from occupancy, rate per occupied room and acquisitions or conversions of expiring leases.
businessLines.description: 752 senior housing communities (independent living, assisted living, memory care, continuing care) owned by Ventas and operated by 39 third-party managers.

operatingProfit.note: Segment NOI (revenue less property-level operating expenses)

businessLines.name: Outpatient medical and research portfolio (OM&R)
businessLines.how: Tenants (health systems, physician groups, universities, biotech and pharma firms) pay rent under leases, with Ventas also earning development and management income; value rides on the nearby hospital or university.
businessLines.description: 409 outpatient medical buildings (mostly on or next to hospital campuses) and research/lab centers.

revenue.note: Includes $2.8M third-party capital management revenue; FY2024 $877.6M

businessLines.revenueNote: Includes $2.8M third-party capital management revenue; FY2024 $877.6M

businessLines.name: Triple-net leased properties (NNN)
businessLines.how: Operators pay fixed rent under long triple-net leases and cover all property costs (maintenance, utilities, taxes, insurance, capex), so Ventas carries credit risk on the tenant rather than operating risk.
businessLines.description: 213 senior housing, skilled nursing, long-term acute care, inpatient rehabilitation and other healthcare facilities leased to operators.

businessLines.name: Non-segment (fees, loans, investments)
businessLines.how: Asset-management and promote fees on other investors' capital plus interest income on loans and investments.
businessLines.description: Management fees and promote revenue from the third-party private capital platform, loans receivable and corporate items; 35 properties held in unconsolidated entities.

operatingProfit.note: Non-segment NOI net of corporate costs
